name: Steinsopp // Bloody Python // Revolver
description:
Oslo-based mushroom rockers Steinsopp bring their own unique blend of groovy, chaotic spaced out sabbath-worshipping stoner riff galore on behalf of the interdimensional mushroom society. 

In addition to keeping the same ol' slow motion blues jam rolling since 2011, they have released two full albums, a split with Tempelheks and a more or less serious compilation of lo-fi improvisations.

After a period of technical maintenance, the Steinsopp fungal vessel is currently all crewed up, including a new-ish vocalist, more than ready for new audio-explorative missions beyond the event horizon.

The band released the session-album "Goloka Sessions" last year - another DIY-monstrosity from the deep forests east of Oslo.
